name: *arr MCP
description: One MCP server for Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr and Prowlarr: search, add and check queues. Fill in the URL and API key of each app you run, and drop the rest. MCP endpoint at /mcp. No auth of its own: anyone who reaches it gets the tools, so untick DNS-resolvable to keep it on the internal network, or put it behind a VPN.
